title: Builder: surface parity for the 21 roles on site, profile, Spotlight and email
detail: Each role has a profile (Frequency frame, no site theme), Spotlight door and email block. Email hides faq, gallery, business, forms and locations and freezes trust, events, circles, plans, booking and services at send. Done when: check:surface-binding resolves every role on all four surfaces and the freeze rule has a test.
